indicator_titration.title: 指示剂酸碱滴定与端点确认
indicator_titration.source_rule: Addition slows near the endpoint; confirmation uses a persistent final colour. This source does not prescribe a universal whole-titration deadline.

source_parameters.conditions: indicator procedure described in this teaching module; not all titrations

indicator_titration.logic: Pause further addition when the candidate endpoint appears; confirm only after continuous persistence. If it fades, resume controlled addition; persistent overshoot is failure.
blockers: mixed colour and dose process model
indicator_titration.caution: The persistence interval is not permission to continue adding titrant; extra response seconds would be engineering thresholds.

iodine_clock.title: 碘钟反应与动力学记录
iodine_clock.source_rule: Start timing at mixing and record the colour-change time, with temperature and trial conditions.
iodine_clock.logic: Measure an unknown induction interval; do not substitute a requested holding duration or an invented reaction-termination deadline.
iodine_clock.caution: Colour-change-to-recording tolerance is an instrument or benchmark parameter unless independently calibrated.

orthophosphate_8114.title: 正磷酸盐显色与限窗读数
orthophosphate_8114.source_rule: The specified 23 C procedure uses a reaction wait followed by a finite reading window; blank and sample have distinct roles.

source_parameters.anchor: instrument reaction timer starts after mixing

source_parameters.conditions: documented 13 C alternative; temperature interference warning retained
documented 33 C alternative; temperature interference warning retained

orthophosphate_8114.logic: At the declared temperature wait for development, zero on the blank, then read the sample in its acquisition window.
orthophosphate_8114.caution: The same method warns of negative bias below 18 C and positive bias above 25 C; do not claim its 13/33 C variants are equally accurate. First design uses 23 C only.

dpd_chlorine.title: 游离氯与总氯的不同读数时序
dpd_chlorine.source_rule: Free and total chlorine have different timing rules despite related colour chemistry.

source_parameters.anchor: reagent addition and mixing in specified method

source_parameters.conditions: specified total chlorine method; not six minutes after waiting

dpd_chlorine.logic: Bind the method label to each sample and schedule its own eligible reading interval.
blockers: method-specific signal model and interference checks
dpd_chlorine.caution: Do not apply one shared waiting time to both methods.

bca_assay.title: BCA显色孵育与批量同步读数
bca_assay.source_rule: The standard test-tube method specifies incubation, cooling and a shared inter-tube reading span; colour continues developing.

source_parameters.anchor: earliest to latest absorbance acquisition across the set
source_parameters.conditions: test-tube procedure after cooling to room temperature

bca_assay.logic: Apply the same treatment to standards and unknowns, then obtain all readings within the cross-sample span.
bca_assay.caution: Ten minutes is an inter-sample acquisition span, not a per-sample deadline from reagent addition.

recrystallization.title: 重结晶、热过滤与分阶段冷却
recrystallization.source_rule: Use hot filtration when appropriate and cool gradually to room temperature before further chilling; observe crystallization.
recrystallization.logic: Branch on insoluble material or absent crystals; preserve thermal and phase state between dissolution, filtration and cooling.
recrystallization.caution: A universal cooling time or invented ten-second hot-filtration deadline is unsupported; purity and yield require separate validation.

gravimetric_constant_mass.title: 沉淀陈化、干燥与恒重判断
gravimetric_constant_mass.source_rule: This sulfate method has a temperature-conditioned digestion interval and repeat heat-cool-weigh cycles until successive masses agree.

source_parameters.conditions: this sulfate method at approximately 90 C
this gravimetric protocol; not a single balance stability reading

gravimetric_constant_mass.logic: Heat, cool and weigh again until the method's successive-mass criterion holds; retain all earlier measurements.
gravimetric_constant_mass.caution: Constant mass compares repeated processing cycles; a single still frame or a fixed waiting time cannot establish it.

liquid_liquid_extraction.title: 分液萃取与状态驱动分层
liquid_liquid_extraction.source_rule: Mix and vent in cycles, allow separation, and use a clear phase boundary before separating the intended layer.
liquid_liquid_extraction.logic: Resume settling if emulsion remains; stop drainage when the selected interface reaches the outlet region.
liquid_liquid_extraction.caution: Fixed venting seconds or universal settling duration are not supported by this source.

melting_point.title: 熔点测定与升温速率切换
melting_point.source_rule: Slow the temperature ramp in the accurate measurement region and record initial and complete melting.

source_parameters.anchor: accurate measurement region near the expected melting point
source_parameters.conditions: the specified apparatus and measurement procedure

melting_point.logic: Change ramp regime as the sample approaches the measurement region; record both phase-transition temperatures.
melting_point.caution: Heater-on duration cannot substitute for measured sample-temperature slope.

aspirin_back_titration.title: 阿司匹林含量分析与回滴
aspirin_back_titration.source_rule: This lesson specifies controlled water-bath heating, cooling and a state-dependent check before back titration.

source_parameters.conditions: this specific lesson before checking and back titration

aspirin_back_titration.logic: Check the specified state after treatment and repeat the indicated preparation branch when necessary before back titration.
aspirin_back_titration.caution: Fifteen and five minutes are method-specific; not universal hydrolysis constants.

winkler_dissolved_oxygen.title: Winkler溶解氧与样品有效期调度
winkler_dissolved_oxygen.source_rule: The archived handbook describes field-fixed samples measured in the laboratory within a holding-time limit.

source_parameters.conditions: this archived Winkler laboratory workflow with field fixation; not a current universal regulatory requirement

winkler_dissolved_oxygen.logic: Preserve sample identity and collection time; prioritize samples approaching their method-specific validity limit.
winkler_dissolved_oxygen.caution: The source is archival. Eight hours cannot become eight seconds without an explicit engineering time transform.

actinometry.title: 光量计与累计有效照射
actinometry.source_rule: Exposure interpretation depends on photon flux, reaction conditions and measurement applicability.
actinometry.logic: Integrate a declared measured exposure model across pauses and occlusions, then compare with the instrument-specific response.
actinometry.caution: No universal light-dose-to-yield equation is claimed; do not replace cumulative dose with a dwell timer.

crystal_violet_kinetics.title: 结晶紫褪色动力学与周期采样
crystal_violet_kinetics.source_rule: Record sample absorbance at a declared cadence over a reaction-time interval, retaining each acquisition timestamp.

source_parameters.anchor: live acquisition begins; retain actual reaction-relative timestamps
source_parameters.conditions: GENESYS crystal-violet live-measurement lesson; do not invent a pre-acquisition t=0 reading
this lesson and its stated experimental conditions

crystal_violet_kinetics.logic: Track the full absorbance-time series and its actual timestamps; missed samples remain missing even if later readings look correct.
crystal_violet_kinetics.caution: Periodic acquisition is distinct from periodically switching a lamp or venting a funnel; timing jitter tolerance still needs an instrumentation contract.
